title: Jack / nut / panel stack
resolution_required: Exact jack lot, EARS nut dimensions/thread, panel thickness, shoulder plane, accessible plug mouth. Fit coupon and insertion-load support. Do not raise entire panel for OCT.

title: OCT / pots / toggle / buttons
resolution_required: Use full pin and body models, shaft datum, nut engagement, swept lever and plunger reach. Qualify board-to-panel depths before routing.

title: Complete one oscillator
resolution_required: Core, power pins, waveform/sine shaping, octave reference, FM/sync ranges and calibration across temperature. Confirm factory programming/calibration or no-firmware design.

title: S&H capture and hold accuracy
resolution_required: LF398M candidate has leakage and offset. Characterize 10 nF and 100 nF storage caps with suitable sample pulse; define acceptable droop vs price before selecting. No ADDAC accuracy claim.

title: SLEW range and hot leakage
resolution_required: Measure lag curve at five knob settings, high-Z leakage, fast endpoint, full-scale jumps, CW direction. 0.5 µF/500 kΩ is proposal; 25 s ADDAC range not implemented.

title: VCF dry path / gain topology
resolution_required: Explicitly freeze which LP/BP/HP paths respond to GAIN and RES; qualify self-oscillation and VCA feedthrough.

title: AR electrical semantics
resolution_required: SIG thresholds/edge/gate/follower scope, CV timing law, EOC/STG pulse/gate behavior, retriggers and curve; UI engine does not define analogue component values.

title: Protection / loading / output shorting
resolution_required: All inputs: negative/high signal and power-off backfeed. All outputs: short and output-output patch; precision outputs maintain stable load-error budget.

title: Connectors and local circuits
resolution_required: Pin maps, keyed mates, returns, current ratings, assembled stack and cable bend. No raw hold, oscillator timing or high-Z lag node through harnesses.

title: Exact zudo-pd integration
resolution_required: Retain source SHA/assembly/NVM. 15 V-only before energization if SMAJ16A is fitted. Budget real rail load, startup/undervoltage/heat/ripple and clearance.

title: Factory assembly and final integration
resolution_required: Confirm all THT/SMD, part procurement, solder profile, supports, LED optics, buttons, connector halves and any final jig/solder operations. No delegated home rework.

title: Native KiCad authority
resolution_required: Source-backed pin/symbol/pad maps, full netlist, design rules, native ERC/DRC, exact assembly models and reviewed DNP. No manufacturing export from the preview.

title: Promote real evidence
resolution_required: Acquire/hash sources into exact-component owner bundles, resolve unavailable docs, add pin maps and routing cases, then generated catalogue. Do not mark a URL as downloaded.

title: Output monitoring connection
resolution_required: No new output module is added. Plan safe attenuation/measurement connection to a user audio interface for test; raw synth outputs are not a headphone driver.
